scientific_scope: One bounded synthetic fit of one shared positive damping scale from the frozen trajectory-only endpoint. Select the scalar from complete train visible-trajectory loss with fresh causal hidden-state initialization at every evaluation; freeze the selected equation before complete train/val/test scoring.
reviewed_checks: All 44 exact implementation/metadata bindings and the six frozen source-file hashes match. The source manifest matches the consumed delayed run. The consumed origin diagnosis has engineering_pass=true, the exact registered receipt hash and damping among its sufficient interventions.

Exactly three NPZ containers are decoded in the registered execution: frozen truth, saved baseline forecasts and the shared equation snapshot. IDs, roles, shapes, float64 finiteness, saved visible resets, source origins, original train scales and original train support are checked. This review hashed containers without decoding them.

Only log_damping_factor is modified. The complete twelve-event train visible array has 311 points and 20 channels; the predictor returns 301 origin/future points and the trajectory loss uses its first 20 channels. Stable events use 300 future points and unstable events use their frozen first-confirmation counts. No truth hidden state, truth-damping penalty, margin-loss weight, val metric or test metric enters scalar selection.

Every objective call recreates zero hidden-state guesses inside predict_from_topology_history and performs the same five Gauss-Newton iterations, radius-one projection, zero prior, actual history warmup and visible-origin reset. No hidden estimate is reused across coefficient evaluations. The whole fitting function runs under torch.no_grad and does not perform parameter-gradient or Adam operations.

The nine-point symmetric log grid includes the exact saved center. Grid ties use loss, distance from center and then index. An interior winner with finite neighbors permits one bounded local refinement at xatol=1e-5. The pinned local SciPy 1.18.0 implementation treats maxiter as maxfun for this bounded method, so at most 24 refinement calls and 33 total objective calls occur.

A boundary winner is retained without expanding the interval. Failed or unavailable refinement retains the measured grid winner with its explicit status. Numerical trial failures store null loss and failure text; infinity is only an internal optimizer sentinel. Engineering validity requires an accepted refined or boundary status, all trial losses finite and strict train-loss reduction. The chosen scalar is restored before CPU checkpoint export and complete final scoring, including when engineering validity is false.

The worst-case envelope is exact: 33 train objective calls consume at most 231 rollouts, 95040 Torch RHS, 13200 tangent RHS and 1980 of each solve operation. One final dual-step causal scoring group with one full batch plus at most 24 single-event isolations per step adds 350 rollouts, 1032000 Torch RHS, 60000 tangent RHS and 480 of each solve. Totals are 581 rollouts, 1127040 Torch RHS, 73200 tangent RHS and 2460 each QR/SVD/triangular/matrix operation, with one fit and three NPZ decodes.

Scientific success requires the registered sufficient-intervention checks against the saved causal baseline separately on train and val: complete paired qualification, newly recovered witnesses without losses, all positive matched witnesses, full eight-second accuracy without unresolved cases, at least five percent unstable-margin RMSE improvement and the overall/truth-stable three/eight-second trajectory guards. Test remains reporting-only. The candidate is frozen and exported before those evaluations.
claim_boundary: Approves this separately registered one-use synthetic scalar fit after policy activation and workflow approval. A successful local bounded search or grid-boundary choice is not a claim of global optimality or real-data validity. The known-truth diagnosis motivated the parameter block but does not supply a fitted truth parameter or hidden state. No additional fit, interval expansion, real-data execution, promotion or reuse of a consumed authorization is approved.
